src: single colored marker pixels on the black background
path: color-coded fixed routes: blue goes two cells right then one up, red goes four left, green goes three down, and pink goes six up
trajectory: paint intermediate route pixels grey and place a same-color marker at each endpoint, preserving the original markers
transform: where a red horizontal segment crosses a green or pink vertical segment, recolor the crossing yellow and extend yellow diagonally down-left to the grid edge
